trials.name: THE BURNING BASEMENT — SUN AND MOON
trials.introMsg: THE BASEMENT OF THE ORIGINAL PIZZERIA — AN INFERNO OF RACKS AND CRATES. MOON DROPS FROM THE CEILING. Find the 5 EXTINGUISHERS and kill the fires. Stay crouched: it HEARS everything. And the flames bite TOO.

tasks.label: Extinguisher — NW, at the rack gap

scares.msg: MOON LETS GO OF THE CEILING AND DROPS FEW METERS AWAY — THE GAME BEGINS
SOMETHING HUGE MOVES BEHIND THE RACKS
THE OLD PIZZERIA'S SONG PLAYS AMONG THE FLAMES... CLOSER AND CLOSER
SOFT FOOTSTEPS... CIRCLING YOU... BETWEEN THE SHELVES
MOON STANDS AT THE END OF THE AISLE — STILL — SMILING THROUGH THE SMOKE
A CHILD'S LAUGH ECHOES FROM THE SPARE-PARTS SHELF
MOON SHRIEKS — IT KNOWS WHERE YOU ARE — THE SMOKE GIVES YOU AWAY
MORE FOOTSTEPS — FASTER — FROM EVERY AISLE AT ONCE
THE FIRE'S ROAR GOES SILENT FOR A SECOND — ONLY YOUR FLASHLIGHT REMAINS
A LOCKER SLAMS SOMEWHERE IN THE DARK
LAST FIRE — MOON ISN'T HIDING ANYMORE — RUN!
THE MOON-FACE SCREAMS ONE LAST TIME

trials.successMsg: THE LAST FIRE DIES. The basement finally breathes... MOON retreats and SUN wakes up in the steam. THE EMERGENCY ROUTE HAS OPENED — south wall. GO.

trials.name: THE SERVICE RELAYS
trials.introMsg: THE MAIN GALLERY IS BLIND DARK. The stenciled pillar knows the order: RELAY 2, THEN 3, THEN 1. Something BROKEN walks the pipes — every relay you flip SCREAMS into the dark.

scares.msg: SERVOS ECHO FROM SOMEWHERE IN THE PIPES
HEAVY STEPS IN THE WATER — NOT YOURS — SLOW — PATIENT
FREDDY'S BROKEN FRAME BLOCKS THE WEST END OF THE GALLERY
THE LAST RELAY SCREAMS — AND SO DOES HE. RUN THE CIRCUIT!

trials.successMsg: THE RELAYS SING. The tunnel lights stutter awake and the RECORDS DOOR hisses open — the FORGOTTEN ARCHIVE waits to the west.

trials.name: BOWLING ALLEY TRIAL
trials.introMsg: TRIAL STARTED — Restart the 3 pinsetters. Bonnie already knows you're here.

scares.msg: SOMETHING HAS ENTERED THE ALLEY WITH YOU
LIGHTS OUT — ONLY YOUR FLASHLIGHT
BONNIE IS WATCHING YOU FROM THE BACK OF LANE 4
BONNIE IS COMING STRAIGHT FOR YOU — LIGHT EVERYTHING UP AND RUN!

trials.successMsg: TRIAL CLEARED — The machines are singing again. Bonnie pulls back... for now.

trials.name: FOOD COURT TRIAL
trials.introMsg: TRIAL STARTED — Restart the 3 food stands before the event. She can smell the pizza... and you.

scares.msg: A CHILD'S LAUGH RUNS THROUGH THE FOOD COURT
SMALL FOOTSTEPS... FAST... BETWEEN THE TABLES
CHICA STANDS BY THE FAR TABLES — SHE DOESN'T BLINK
THE COURT GOES DARK — SHE DOESN'T NEED LIGHT

trials.successMsg: TRIAL CLEARED — The stands roar with power. Chica settles down with the aroma... for now.

trials.name: PIRATE'S COVE TRIAL
trials.introMsg: TRIAL STARTED — Restore power to the attraction (3 switches, in order). Foxy is VERY fast. Keep moving.

scares.msg: THE COVE'S CURTAIN SWAYS WITH NO WIND
FOXY POKES OUT BETWEEN THE CURTAINS — THE PATCHED EYE GLOWS
THE COVE GOES DARK — ONLY METAL CAN BE HEARD
FOXY IS RUNNING! THE FLASHLIGHT STOPS HIM FOR AN INSTANT — KEEP HIM IN YOUR SIGHTS!

trials.successMsg: TRIAL CLEARED — The attraction roars with power. Foxy returns behind his curtain, whistling. One keycard closer...

trials.name: GENERATORS TRIAL — MASTER PANEL
trials.introMsg: THE MASTER PANEL — order 3 · 1 · 4 · 2, exactly like the note says. Freddy already heard the three generators you started tonight.

scares.msg: THE GENERATOR ROOM HUMS IN THE DARK
A SHADOW PASSES BETWEEN THE GENERATORS
FREDDY HAS SEEN YOU — KEEP THE GENERATORS OUT OF HIS PATH!
SOMETHING ELSE STIRS BY THE SOUTH DOOR — THE NIGHT SHIFT IS NOT YOURS ALONE

trials.successMsg: POWER RESTORED — the MEGAPLEX breathes again: atrium, promenades, galleries. Now... check that noise in the arcade.

trials.name: THE HALLWAY OF SOUNDS
trials.introMsg: THE TECHNICAL GALLERY IS BLIND DARK. LISTEN TO THE DOORS — RULO WILL TELL YOU WHICH ONE TO ENTER.
trials.successMsg: ALL THREE DOORS CORRECT — the gallery exhales. Now... GET BACK TO THE OFFICE. The night isn't done with you.

rounds.hint: ROUND 1 — Enter where the FAN HUMS (the empty room).
ROUND 2 — Enter where the POTS CLANG (Chica already left).
ROUND 3 — Enter where it is TRULY SILENT.

trials.name: THE OFFICE — DON'T MAKE A SOUND
trials.introMsg: THEY KNOW WHERE YOU SLEEP. Two doors. One music box. REAL steps come in fours and STOP. Fake ones loop. Keep the PRIZE COUNTER box wound (CAM 17) — and SURVIVE until the motors cool.
trials.successMsg: THE MOTORS COOL DOWN. The steps back away into the dark... the office is yours again. The night shifts beneath your feet — it's time to go DOWN.
